changes: No substantive changes; added notes on the scribe's name (possibly Svarūpacanda) and on the CE year (Pauṣa kṛṣṇa of VS 1839 falls around Dec 1782 to Jan 1783)

notes: The catalogue gives the scribe as 'Sarupracaṃda vaiśya ?', but the colophon reads 'sarupacaṃda vaiśya'. This is probably Sarūpacanda/Svarūpacanda; vaiśya is a caste label. 'līpikṛtaṃ' repeats the scribe statement. The era is not named ('saṃvat'), but VS fits the Devanagari, non-Nepal context. VS 1839 Pauṣa kṛṣṇa 12 falls around December 1782 (pūrṇimānta) or January 1783 (amānta), so ce_approx could be 1782 or 1783.
